# sfcompute_instance_ssh (Data Source)

Reads instance ssh from SF Compute (`GET /v2/instances/{id}/ssh`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sfcompute_instance_ssh" "devbox" {
  id = "inst_k3RnX9vLm7Qp2Yw5Jd8F"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) A resource path like 'sfc:instance:acme:prod:my-instance' _or_ an ID. Resource paths are human-readable but not stable - they change when resources are renamed or moved. IDs are stable and permanent.

### Read-Only

- `host_keys` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--host_keys))
- `hostname` (String)
- `last_attempted_key_update_at` (Number) Unix timestamp of the last attempted host key refresh.
- `last_successful_key_update_at` (Number) Unix timestamp of the last successful host key refresh.
- `port` (Number)

<a id="nestedatt--host_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `host_keys`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) Base64-encoded public key.
- `key_type` (String) Key algorithm.
